instruction: Turn on the sink and manuever the spout to wash all locations of the sink basin.

stage_definitions.counts_as_complete: water is running from the faucet.
stage_definitions.does_not_count: the faucet is still off (no water stream), even if the gripper is touching the handle.

stage_definitions.counts_as_complete: while the water was running, the spout has been turned to all three positions — left, centre and right (in any order, over the course of the video).
stage_definitions.does_not_count: the water is off, or the spout has not yet been pointed in all three directions with water running.
